movie_title: How creative should we be? 6 Minute English
introduction: Improve your English vocabulary and speaking with 6 Minute English!  The World Economic Forum foreca

vocabulary.definition: the ability to form mental images or concepts of things that are not present to the senses
vocabulary.example: His imagination knew no bounds as he created a whole new world in his novel.

vocabulary.definition: to predict or estimate a future event or trend
vocabulary.example: The meteorologist forecasted heavy rain for the weekend.

vocabulary.definition: in a way that is fair, reasonable, and conforms to the law
vocabulary.example: The company legitimately acquired the land for their new headquarters.

vocabulary.definition: to remedy or set right (an undesirable or unfair situation)
vocabulary.example: The new policy aims to redress the gender imbalance in the workplace.

vocabulary.definition: fundamentally distinct or different in kind
vocabulary.example: The team had to find a way to connect disparate ideas to form a coherent strategy.

vocabulary.definition: a state of mental clarity and focus, especially when making decisions or solving problems
vocabulary.example: Taking a walk in the park helps me clear my headspace and come up with new ideas.
